'''Dina Mertz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] chief [[Technician/Legends|tech]] officer in [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] criminal [[Organization]]. She was a pretty young girl who tied her hair in two bouncing but stiff tails that looked similar to [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]].

She worked for [[Nirama]]'s organization in the asteroid space station [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]], in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]].

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], she received smuggler [[Xav Verivax]], who tried to flirt with her. She then took a team of undercover agents who had came in Verivax's ship to see her boss, [[Vin Tal'benes]].

Mertz was not as grumpy as most of the people in Darkside, but she was not really extrovert either.
